hypotheses.justification: The theorem also holds when n = 0. Then every summand of VeroneseRing 𝒮 0 has coefficient type 𝒮 0; the summand at index 0 is the base component, and each summand at index j > 0 is generated by products of elements from component 𝒮 0 1 (use coefficient a in one degree-one factor and coefficient 1 in the other j−1 factors). Thus the conclusion holds without hgen in this case. For n > 0, the proof proceeds as given, retaining hn for eval_mem_adjoin and zeroRingEquiv.
